sqlite:
CREATE TABLE app_settings (
	"key" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	value JSON NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE device_endpoints (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	device_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	waiting_room VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	client_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	last_heartbeat_at DATETIME, 
	last_event_id VARCHAR(36), 
	last_acknowledged_event_id VARCHAR(36), 
	fault VARCHAR(240), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (client_key_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE holidays (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	holiday_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_holidays_holiday_date ON holidays (holiday_date)

CREATE TABLE lookup_options (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	value VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_lookup_category_value UNIQUE (category, value)
)

CREATE TABLE patients (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	patient_number VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(30), 
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	mobile VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	date_of_birth DATE, 
	sex VARCHAR(20), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_patients_patient_number ON patients (patient_number)

CREATE TABLE registration_counters (
	year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (year)
)

CREATE TABLE role_definitions (
	name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	access_profile VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	permissions JSON NOT NULL, 
	is_system BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (name)
)

CREATE TABLE sms_messages (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	mobile VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	message_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	body VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	provider_reference VARCHAR(120), 
	error VARCHAR(500), 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_attempt_at DATETIME, 
	claimed_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	sent_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE waiting_rooms (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	floor VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	display_label VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	audio_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	display_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_waiting_rooms_code ON waiting_rooms (code)

CREATE TABLE doctors (
	id VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	department VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	designation VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	room_number VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	waiting_room_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_prefix VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(waiting_room_id) REFERENCES waiting_rooms (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_prefix)
)

CREATE TABLE queue_controls (
	doctor_id VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	is_paused BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(240), 
	updated_by VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (doctor_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors (id)
)

CREATE TABLE schedule_slots (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	doctor_id VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	starts_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	ends_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_doctor_slot_start UNIQUE (doctor_id, starts_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors (id)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	must_change_password BOOLEAN DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	doctor_id VARCHAR(60), 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_username ON users (username)

CREATE TABLE appointments (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	appointment_number VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	patient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	doctor_id VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	slot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(240), 
	notes TEXT, 
	created_by VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	checked_in_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(slot_id) REFERENCES schedule_slots (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_appointments_appointment_number ON appointments (appointment_number)

CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE queue_tokens (
	custom_fields JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_number VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	serial_number VARCHAR(30), 
	age INTEGER, 
	unit VARCHAR(160), 
	mri_area VARCHAR(240), 
	contrast INTEGER, 
	film INTEGER, 
	report TEXT, 
	beneficiary_type VARCHAR(100), 
	service_status VARCHAR(100), 
	entitlement VARCHAR(100), 
	family_relationship VARCHAR(100), 
	summary_category VARCHAR(100), 
	summary_category_source VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'automatic' NOT NULL, 
	patient_source VARCHAR(100), 
	ward_text VARCHAR(240), 
	patient_title VARCHAR(30), 
	patient_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	patient_name_bn VARCHAR(480), 
	patient_phone VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	service_category VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	rank VARCHAR(100), 
	service_number VARCHAR(40), 
	doctor_id VARCHAR(60), 
	doctor_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	department VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	room_number VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	waiting_room VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	priority VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	called_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	skipped_at DATETIME, 
	recalled_at DATETIME, 
	no_show_at DATETIME, 
	cancelled_at DATETIME, 
	recall_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	patient_id VARCHAR(36), 
	appointment_id VARCHAR(36), 
	scheduled_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_daily_doctor_sequence UNIQUE (token_date, doctor_id, sequence), 
	UNIQUE (serial_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(patient_id) REFERENCES patients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_queue_tokens_appointment_id ON queue_tokens (appointment_id)

CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	token_id VARCHAR(36), 
	previous_status VARCHAR(20), 
	new_status VARCHAR(20), 
	reason TEXT, 
	detail JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(token_id) REFERENCES queue_tokens (id)
)

CREATE TABLE call_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	waiting_room VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(token_id) REFERENCES queue_tokens (id)
)
